  </picture>
  <picture>

<!--
  The three images above are committed by three nightly workflows:
    .github/workflows/koi.yml     -> koi/koi.gif
    .github/workflows/bonsai.yml  -> output/bonsai.gif
    .github/workflows/cards.yml   -> cards/*.svg
  Run each one once from the Actions tab so they appear before the first night.
  Replace OWNER with your username.
-->
